title: Commandin' Presence
description:
Aren't thay a beauty? congratulations, ya've gotten yourself yo-wr fuhrst pahrtner.  Now ya wanna know command 'em.  Doin' so is cut and dry, jus' look at yo-wr hoss eend hit thuh command wheel key (Default: R).  Ya'll be shown [a radial menu](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/horse_command_wheel.png:128:74), a cuhrcule ifin' ya will.  Clickin' outsaahd thuh cuhrcule will culohs it. 
ya've gawt a few options.  Thair's awf course thuh culassic "follow," "stay," eend "wander," but also "set" eend "return" home.  Choosin' "set home" will mark thuh area as home an set yo-wr hoss ta stay, an choosin' "return home" will git yo-wr hoss ta wawk back ta wherevher home is.
